scope: All final images and actual-size 320px simulations were visually reviewed by AI agents. Shared-CSS 320/360/detail examples were inspected in the native Codex browser. This audit does not claim individual native browsing of all 299 production routes. Root verifies representative complete production routes separately before publication.
limitations: Sharp card sheets are simulations, not browser screenshots.
Native example pages isolate production image CSS, not complete production routes.
Microcopy need not be readable in thumbnails; primary message or recognizable product subject must remain visible.
Reviewer/operator names are attestations, not cryptographic authentication.
Product-site numeric and marketing claims pictured are not independently endorsed.
